text: Three cargo vessels are struck by projectiles in or near the Strait of Hormuz, including one vessel 11 nautical miles north of Oman that catches fire and evacuates crew. Additional damage reports occur near the UAE coast. Maritime authorities issue transit warnings as vessel movement through the waterway remains minimal.

meta.note: Shipping disruption overlaps with military activity; classification chosen for trade-flow constraint rather than battlefield action.

text: U.S. consumer price index rises 0.3% month over month and 2.4% year over year in February, matching consensus forecasts. Core CPI records 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annual increases. Shelter and services prices increase modestly while several goods categories decline, leaving the annual inflation rate unchanged from January.

meta.note: Energy shock mentioned in reporting occurs outside the CPI observation window and is excluded from classification.
